$comment: Single source of truth for cardiology measures shared by the HLS cardiology read API and the caldova-cardio-e2e agent platform. Keys match the platform scorer's MeasureSpec.key. Codes identify what is measured; units are UCUM. maxAgeSeconds decides when a value is reported stale. SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY.

measures.label: Heart rate
measures.notes: Not interchangeable with Heart rate by Pulse oximetry (LOINC 8889-8) from the Masimo stream; the API never substitutes one for the other.

measures.label: Oxygen saturation
measures.notes: Same code the HLS canonical Synthea fixture already emits.

measures.label: Device flow index
measures.notes: No standard code exists for this demonstration measure. Produced only by the synthetic cardiac-device feed.
